name: Nickelodeon GUTS
description: This action-packed half-hour lets kids loose in a fantasy sports landscape filled with crazy obstacles. Basketball is taken to its limits in Slam Dunk while rock climbing reaches new heights on the Aggro Crag.

videos.title: Nickelodeon GUTS All-Stars
videos.overview:
Hour-long special where three former players from the previous season, Mike "Superman" Schmidt, Jana "The Warrior" Waring, and Kelli "The Maniac" Marchewka, who achieved 1,925 points compete against each other for a college scholarship and a special GUTS All-Star trophy.

This special never reran on Nick GaS, most likely because it was an hour long instead of the usual half-hour.

videos.title: The Road to the Extreme Arena: Behind The Scenes of Global GUTS
videos.overview:
A special on the making of Nickelodeon GUTS made during the Global GUTS season of the show. The episode was buried with other Nickelodeon momentums in the "Nickelodeon Time Capsule" in 1994.

This special has only aired on special days and was never released on VHS nor DVD.

videos.title: Angela - Luke - Natalie
videos.overview: This episode seems to be lost. It is not on any streaming services, nor was it rerun on Nick GaS. It was last re-run on October 25, 1998.
